Let’s call this what it is: the ruling class ruthlessly tightening the screws of global apartheid and systemic xenophobia. On March 26, 2026, we saw the true face of state power with the royal assent of Bill C-12, officially titled the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act. This is a direct, violent assault on the dignity of marginalized migrants, plain and simple. 

They try to dress this up as border management or the public interest, but we know better. This is institutional power weaponizing borders to criminalize Black and brown bodies. By slamming the door on Nigerians and other vulnerable populations with harsher immigration and asylum rules, the state is actively punishing people who are simply trying to survive the devastation wreaked by global inequality and imperialist exploitation. 

Make no mistake, this legislation exists purely to protect global capital and entrenched labor hierarchies on the backs of human lives. You cannot reform a system built from the ground up on exclusion and discrimination. We need radical institutional reform and the total dismantling of these hostile immigration regimes. True justice means the unconditional protection of the most vulnerable, not this draconian policing.
